name: Guangzhou Metro Design & Research Institute Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Metro Design & Research Institute Co., Ltd. provides engineering consultancy services. The company provides professional technical services, including survey and design, planning consultation, and general contracting for rail transit, municipal, construction, and other construction projects. It also offers measurement services; standardization services; planning and design management; engineering management services; environmental protection monitoring; geological surveys; professional design services; fire protection technical services; disaster risk assessment; national land space planning; safety production; construction project quality inspection; engineering survey and design;…
